svg.title: Four runs, four shapes, read before any label
svg.desc: Four runs of trace_loop.py drawn as strips of spans on one axis from 0 to 21 simulated seconds: blue model calls, orange tool calls, a purple gate. Run 1, healthy, alternates model and tool spans over six iterations and ends with a gate that passes, completed. Run 3, a doom loop with exit (4) off, repeats one read_file call twelve times, the repeats edged in red, with no gate, and stops at the cap, max_iters. Run 6, an ungated answer, stops after two iterations, completed, with a dashed empty slot where a gate would be. Run 4, a growing context, makes seven model calls that widen as the history grows and stops on exit (3), budget, at 107,100 input tokens against a ceiling of 100,000, the last call edged in red.
svg.text: Four runs, four shapes, read before any label
Computed by trace_loop.py: simulated seconds on one axis; tokens are the series' illustrative run.
The doom loop never converges; the victory declaration is read from what is missing.
